text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Failure is an inherent part of hunting. 
There are simply days like this.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I have tasted such frustration many times 
myself, 
so I know all too well how you must feel.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
However, it is precisely at times like 
these 
that one must keep a calm composure.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Rushing forward in frustration leads to 
careless moves, which can invite true 
disaster.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
For now, please get some proper rest. 
Thank you very much, Trainer.
